Spreadsheet Audit & Route Feasibility Analysis

Issues detected in Trip_Budget_Riverston.xlsx and automatically fixed in this app

1. Trip Dates & Duration Fixed

Excel listed 2027-01-15 to 2027-10-16 (9 months) and 2 Days, while booking 2 Villa nights & 3 days of meals/schedule. Standardized to Jan 15–17, 2027 (3 Days / 2 Nights).

2. Net Balance, Donations & Share % Fixed

Excel had hardcoded 0 in Category Est. Share % and Member Net Balance / Refund. Both now auto-calculate live alongside name-by-name Central Pool Donations.

3. Aqua Car Hire vs. 5 Adults + Gear

LKR 5,000 for 2-day Aqua hire is well below standard rental rates (unless using Muthumala's personal car). Also watch ground clearance on the rough road to Sera Ella / Kuda Ella with 5 adults + BBQ gear.

4. Day 1 Matale to Villa Timing & Tickets

Breakfast at Matale (8:30 AM) to Villa check-in (9:00 AM) leaves only 30 mins for a 35 km winding climb via Rattota (B274). Allow ~1.5 hrs and budget ~LKR 1,500–2,500 for Pitawala Pathana & Riverston conservation tickets.

Pool & Reimbursement Settlement Plan

Exact step-by-step transfers to settle everyone's target share (accounting for pool cash, direct bills, and donations).

How Pool, Donations & Direct Payer Accounting Works

  • 1 Cash Collected to Pool: Enter how much cash each friend hands over to the central trip fund before or during the trip.
  • 2 Donations by Name: Any donation added above goes directly into the Central Pool. In Reduce Member Share mode, a LKR 10,000 donation lowers the 5-person target from LKR 20,000 to LKR 18,000 each!
  • 3 Net Balance / Refund: Automatically calculated as (Cash Collected + Direct Bills Paid) − Target Share.
